0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>The lovesick Nu Mou is struggling to make a decision.

25.original: Report to the lovesick Nu Mou.

48.original: Should I give them this...or should I give them that? Gah, I can't decide!

49.original: There's someone I fancy, and I want to give them a gift, but I don't know what manner of item is best... To get an idea, I thought about asking some of the others what they would like to receive, but I worry that they'll mistake my question as a proposition.

50.original: If the question were to come from you, though, it wouldn't be a concern. Please, will you go and do the asking in my stead?

51.original: Please, ask some of the others here what manner of gift they would like to receive. It will help me to decide what to give to my special someone.

52.original: What I would be happy to receive? I suppose a grimoire wouldn't go astray. It never hurts to have more knowledge.

53.original: I'm afraid this is rather unimaginative, but I'm quite partial to flowers. We can't grow them in the cave, and they would help to brighten up the village.

54.original: My choice of a gift? Why, a porxie, for certain. There's nothing more useful than a trusty familiar, and the more adorable it is, the better.

55.original: What I would be happy to receive? I suppose a grimoire wouldn't go astray. It never hurts to have more knowledge.

56.original: I'm afraid this is rather unimaginative, but I'm quite partial to flowers. We can't grow them in the cave, and they would help to brighten up the village.

57.original: My choice of a gift? Why, a porxie, for certain. There's nothing more useful than a trusty familiar, and the more adorable it is, the better.

58.original: You've spoken with the others? Please tell me what you learned!

59.original: I see, I see... Yes, I believe I can finally decide! Thank you ever so much!

60.original: When I was little, a mortal told me that a gift isn't something one must give, but something one <hex:021A020203>wants<hex:021A020103> to give. For a long time, I didn't understand what his words meant. But that changed when I met...<hex:021A020203>them<hex:021A020103>.

61.original: Simply thinking of them makes me want to give them a gift. And thanks to you, I'm confident I can choose one that will bring a smile to their face. Please accept this as a fitting payment for your kind help.
